StringProperty.Name: GameDirectory
StringProperty.Description: Directory where .dll will be deployed to and game .exe will be run from

StringProperty.Name: ScriptName
StringProperty.Description: Name of the script, used as the .script package filename and in info.json

StringProperty.Name: ScriptVersion
StringProperty.Description: Version of the script (e.g. 1.0.0), written into info.json

StringProperty.Name: ScriptType
StringProperty.Description: Type written into info.json: 'script' for a regular script, 'lib' for a library

StringProperty.Name: ScriptAuthor
StringProperty.Description: Author of the script, written into info.json

StringProperty.Name: ScriptDependencies
StringProperty.Description: Comma-separated list of dependencies in Name:Version format, e.g. MSMR-Script-SDK:1.0.0
